title: 水彩のひつじと年賀状のモチーフ
subject_en: Soft watercolour sheep and New Year motifs for 2027 greeting cards, each a separate object; the sheep is gently realistic (not a mascot): fluffy wool in warm cream (#FFF6E0, never pure white) with soft grey-beige shadows, a kind face, small curled horns. Outlines are closed thin pencil-like lines darker than the fill.
lead: 水彩でやわらかく描いた、ひつじと年賀状の素材12点。大人っぽい年賀状、寒中見舞い、お店のお知らせに。親子のひつじ、梅、松竹梅、富士山、鏡もちなど。
